summary: Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of a two-sheet implication in the aligned nontrivial cubic-Kummer analysis at actual partial degrees (6,9). Every field-valued solution of the four lower-Pfaffian invariant equations is proved to lie on a common-power sheet with zero source bracket or on an elliptic sheet; converse inclusions and existence of the sheets are not compared.
